mapper.select:
SELECT ft.id, ft.instance_id, wi.number, wi.business_type, ft.node_code, ft.node_name, (fi.activity_status = 1) AS active, string_agg(DISTINCT fu.processed_by, ',' ORDER BY fu.processed_by) AS candidate_ids, ft.create_time FROM flow_task ft JOIN flow_instance fi ON fi.id = ft.instance_id AND fi.del_flag = '0' JOIN t_workflow_instance wi ON wi.id = ft.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_user fu ON fu.associated = ft.id AND fu.type IN ('1', '2', '3') AND fu.del_flag = '0' WHERE ft.del_flag = '0'
AND (wi.number ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR wi.business_type ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ft.node_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY ft.id, ft.instance_id, wi.number, wi.business_type, ft.node_code, ft.node_name, fi.activity_status, ft.create_time ORDER BY ft.create_time DESC, ft.id DESC
